notice.hint: Use "Add printer" to install one from the network or by IP address, or press Rescan.
notice.noHost: Printers are read from the operating system — run the MaeclyPrint desktop app to manage them.

tooltip.policyLocked: Your organization manages the default printer
tooltip.restoreFirst: Restore this printer before setting it as default

confirm.testPageMessage: Send a test page to {{name}}? It will print on paper.
confirm.removeAppDefault: It is MaeclyPrint's default printer: that setting will be cleared.
confirm.removeRoutes_one: Files of type {{exts}} are routed to it; while it is removed they go to the default printer instead.
confirm.removeRoutes_other: Files of type {{exts}} are routed to it; while it is removed they go to the default printer instead.
confirm.removeOsDefault: It is also the system's default printer, so jobs left on System default will not print until you choose another default printer.

toast.defaultSetPartial: {{name}} is now the system default, but MaeclyPrint could not save it as its own default.
toast.testPageSent: Test page sent to {{name}} — if nothing comes out, check the printer's own queue.
toast.removedUnknownOs: Removed {{name}} from MaeclyPrint (the system print queue is untouched)
toast.clearedTray: Default tray now follows the printer
toast.clearedPaper: Default paper now follows the printer
toast.referencesRemoved: Removed references to the missing printer

missing.title: Printer referenced by MaeclyPrint settings is no longer available
missing.body: {{id}} is referenced by your MaeclyPrint settings, but the system spooler no longer reports it. Jobs sent to it are {{outcome}} until you reassign or forget it.
missing.reassignLabel: Printer to take over the missing printer's rules

policy.managed: Default printer {{name}} is managed by your organization via {{file}}.
policy.managedMissing: Your organization pins the default printer to {{id}} via {{file}}, but the system spooler does not currently report it. Ask your administrator, or add it via Add printer.

defaults.label: Defaults for this printer
defaults.noTrays: This driver reports no selectable trays.
defaults.noPapers: This driver reports no paper sizes.

routes.label: Route file types here
routes.hint: Files with these extensions default to this printer when no profile overrides it.
routes.skippedWhileRemoved: These rules are skipped while the printer is removed: those files go to the default printer.

capabilities.label: Capabilities
capabilities.duplexWarning: Jobs that ask for two-sided printing will pause on this printer until you switch them to one-sided or choose another printer.

network.intro: Printers on your network, discovered via mDNS / Bonjour. Not listed? Try {{byIp}}, or {{openSettings}} for USB and other transports.
network.scanning: Scanning the network via mDNS / Bonjour…
network.empty: No new printers found on the network.
network.unsupported: Network discovery is not available on Windows yet, so nothing was scanned. Add the printer with {{byIp}}, or use {{openSettings}}.

ip.hostInvalid: Enter an IPv4 address (10.0.0.41), a host name (printer.local) or an IPv6 address in brackets ([fe80::1]), without ipp:// or spaces.
ip.portInvalid: The port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
ip.windowsNote: Windows installs IPP / IPPS queues only. Add raw (9100), LPD, or USB printers via {{openSettings}}.

system.intro: Queues already known to {{os}}. Unticking one hides it from MaeclyPrint (soft-disable) — the OS print queue is left untouched.
system.introUnknownOs: Queues the operating system already reports. Unticking one hides it from MaeclyPrint (soft-disable) — the OS print queue is left untouched.
